subject: Emotions
title: Parental Love
description: A quick win: understand Parental Love.

hook.text: A mother lifts a car off her trapped child. Parental love doesn't just change how you feel—it changes what you can do.

buildup.text: Parental love is an attachment system millions of years old. It's the oldest and most powerful form of human bonding.

discovery.text: Brain scans show parents viewing their child activate the same reward circuits as cocaine. The intensity is biochemical.

twist.text: Parental love isn't automatic. Postpartum depression hits 15% of mothers, and bonding failure is commoner than we think.

climax.text: Adoptive parents show identical neural bonding patterns after time together. Love runs on interaction, not genetics.

punchline.text: Parental love isn't in the blood. It's in the time.
